name: Berserker Elixir
description: Increases Attack by 20% but decreases Defense by 5%.

name: Critical Potion
description: Increases Critical Rate by 10 percentage points.

name: Guardian Elixir
description: Increases Defense by 20% but decreases Speed by 5%.

name: Phoenix Essence
description: Revives the character once with 20% HP after being defeated.

name: Focus Elixir
description: Increases Accuracy by 15% and Critical Rate by 5 percentage points.

name: Elemental Tonic
description: Increases damage for the character's element by 15%.

name: Mystic Focus
description: Increases Magic Attack by 15% and Mana Recovery by 10%.

name: Full Recovery Elixir
description: Restores 50% of Maximum HP and 50% of Maximum Mana.

name: Equipment Enhancement Stone
description: Material for increasing equipment enhancement level.

name: Stat Reset Crystal
description: Resets allocated character stat points for redistribution.
